children: fell nearly 10% on Thursday, after Grizzly Research disclosed a short position, alleging the Austrian lender was involved in $1.19 billion of Russian trade in goods subject to Western sanctions and restrictions.

Grizzly said in a report published on its website that Raiffeisen "has become a key channel for sanctions circumvention in Russia's wartime economy, while assuring investors, regulators and the public that it is winding down its business there."
Raiffeisen said it had seen a number of factually wrong and misleading statements in an initial review of Grizzly comments.
By 0743 GMT, the stock was down 8.7%, trimming year-to-date gains to 55%.
